headline: Last session: Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 as banking stocks and foreign inflows lifted markets

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Banking and IT stocks supported a sharp recovery during the final session of the week.
Foreign institutional inflows provided a significant lift to the domestic markets on Friday.
The Nifty and Sensex extended their winning streak to four consecutive weeks with 3% gains.
Initial market pressure from a global AI selloff was overcome by strong domestic buying interest.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is closed today, November 21, for the weekend.
Trading is scheduled to resume on Monday, November 23, 2026.
Investors are monitoring a potential market holiday on November 24 for Guru Nanak Jayanti.
Global oil prices are projected to normalize to $70 by 2027 as the market moves into surplus.
summary: In the last session, Indian markets staged a major recovery with the Sensex jumping 898 points to reclaim key levels. The rally was driven by banking and IT sectors, helping the main indices secure a 3% gain over the past four weeks. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will reopen on Monday.
